title: DeepKids
music: DeepKids (first draft melody and chords, made in code)
about: The DeepKids song, for the start of the day.

sections.name: Verse
lines: We feel the love in our hearts;
See the World with no chains;
Oh yeah we got all the smarts.
Because all comes from the heart.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Although we cry, we ask why;
And never let it go just with a sigh.
Oh yes we got all the smarts.
Is there anyone who can dream better than a child.

sections.name: Bridge
lines: There is no place free-er than our minds.

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Listen to what we have to say.
